body.prompt: The woman in the reference images, the same face throughout. She moves slowly from Praṇāmāsana, standing, palms together at the chest into Hasta Uttānāsana, arms raised overhead, gentle backbend. One slow continuous yoga movement with the breath, nothing else moves. Fixed camera, eye level, full body always in frame, feet on the same ground line. A soft dawn sky behind her: deep indigo above fading through dusty rose into a warm ochre haze at the ground line, no clouds, no buildings, a quiet glow near the horizon, first light, no props, no text, no other people. Photoreal, her face unchanged, hair tied back the whole time, clothing and body unchanged throughout, hands and feet keep contact with the floor when they are on it. Calm editorial pacing. Her palms stay together at the chest, then the joined hands rise straight up in front of her face to overhead and she arches gently back; the arms never swing down or behind the back; hair in a tied bun throughout.
